ja178:1.1: Janittaṃ me bhavittaṃ me, iti paṃke avassayiṃ, taṃ maṃ paṃko ajjhobhavi yathā dubbalakaṃ tathā, taṃ taṃ vadāmi bhaggava, suṇohi vacanaṃ mama:
ja178:2.1: Gāme vā yadi vāraññe sukhaṃ yatrādhigacchati taṃ janittaṃ bhavittañ ca purisassa pajānato yamhi jīve tamhi gacche, na niketahato siyā ti.
